bio_en: Mihrdat Mirzakhanian was born in Van in 1886 into a wealthy family and educated at the Yeramian school; raised within the ARF, he lived as hard-working a life as any peasant. In the April 1915 defence of Van he was one of the few dozen heroes who held out for a month against the besieging enemy. During the February 1921 uprising against the Bolsheviks he was a notable fighter of the people's army, fighting under machine-gun and armoured-train fire. Badly wounded, he died of blood poisoning on 2 March 1921.
